def is_plain_name(name: str) -> bool:
    """True when name is a single non-empty path component: no separators, no NUL, not "." or "..", not absolute or drive-prefixed."""
    ex is_plain_name("a.txt") == True
    ex is_plain_name("") == False
    ex is_plain_name("..") == False
    ex is_plain_name("../x") == False
    ex is_plain_name("a/b") == False
    ex is_plain_name("a\\b") == False
    ex is_plain_name("/etc/passwd") == False
    if name == "" or name == "." or name == "..":
        return False
    for c in name.chars():
        if c == "/" or c == "\\" or c == "\0" or c == ":":
            return False
    return True

def read_note(name: str) -> str uses fs:
    """Text of the file `name` inside the directory `notes`, or "" if the name is not a plain single file name, or the file is missing or unreadable. Runs with fs confined to `notes`, so no name can reach outside it."""
    post is_plain_name(name) or out == ""
    if not is_plain_name(name):
        return ""
    with fs = fs.sub("notes"):
        return fs.read_text(name) else ""
